description: This file defines the LayerTraceEntry class and associated functions for processing layer trace data, including parsing protocol buffer objects into LayerTraceEntry instances, adding attributes, and creating Display objects.

classes.name: LayerTraceEntry
classes.description: Represents a trace entry for a layer, including methods to create instances from protocol buffer data.

classes.name: Display
classes.description: Represents a display object used within layer trace entries.

classes.name: LayerTraceEntryBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing LayerTraceEntry instances.

methods.name: LayerTraceEntry.fromProto
methods.description: Creates a LayerTraceEntry instance from protocol buffer objects, display data, timestamps, and other metadata.

methods.name: addAttributes
methods.description: Adds debugging and display properties to a LayerTraceEntry instance.

methods.name: newDisplay
methods.description: Creates a Display object from a protocol buffer.
